meta.name: nanoresearch-writing
meta.description: Draft a LaTeX research paper from all previous stage outputs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将研究阶段成果汇编成 LaTeX 论文草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有研究笔记或实验数据，需要快速生成论文初稿
copy.tagline_en: Compile research stage outputs into a LaTeX paper draft
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have research notes or experimental data and need a quick paper draft

howto.what: 该技能会读取之前阶段的研究构思、实验设计和实验结果，自动生成一篇完整的 LaTeX 论文草稿，包括摘要、引言、方法、实验等章节，并生成图表、参考文献，最后编译成 PDF 文件。
howto.when: 当用户提供之前阶段的 ideation 输出、实验蓝图和实验结果，并要求生成论文草稿时触发。

say.text: 根据之前的 ideation 和实验数据，写一篇 LaTeX 论文草稿。
say.note: 会读取对应文件并生成完整论文。

say.text: 把前面的实验设计整理成论文，并生成图表和参考文献。
请用当前工作区的输出生成论文 PDF。
say.note: 编译成功后会得到 main.pdf。

howto.what_en: This skill reads the ideation, planning and experiment outputs from previous stages and automatically drafts a complete LaTeX research paper, including abstract, introduction, method, and experiments sections, and generates figures, tables, references, and finally compiles it into a PDF.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides the ideation output, experiment blueprint, and experiment results from previous stages and asks to draft a paper.

say_en.text: Write a LaTeX paper draft from the previous ideation and experiment data.
say_en.note: Reads the files and produces the full paper.

say_en.text: Turn the experiment design into a paper with figures, tables and references.
Generate a paper PDF from the outputs in the current workspace.
